name: Stateful tests
statusMessage:
1. Test Case ID: ZQpHqz

- Resource is not available after creation

    The API returned `404 Not Found` for a resource that was just created.

    Created with      : `POST /api/colors`
    Not available with: `PUT /api/colors/{name}`

[404] Not Found:

    `{"error":"Color not found"}`

Reproduce with:

    curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"hex": "#1f1bae", "name": "2jyg+0CgE0Fhy Q3FpdfNH9bZuB0gPvUF"}' http://127.0.0.1:5001/api/colors
    curl -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "2jyg+0CgE0Fhy Q3FpdfNH9bZuB0gPvUF"}' http://127.0.0.1:5001/api/colors/2jyg%2B0CgE0Fhy+Q3FpdfNH9bZuB0gPvUF
